llmJudgeRequirements.description: App component renders `QueryClientProvider` with `client` set to `queryClient` and wraps `TodosScreen`
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: App component renders only <TodosScreen /> with no QueryClientProvider wrapping it and no queryClient instance created at app level.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Toggle flow uses `useMutation` object form with `mutationFn` `onMutate` `onError` and `onSettled` callbacks
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: useMutation is called with object form containing mutationFn, onMutate, onError, and onSettled callbacks.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must call `cancelQueries` from `onMutate`, read snapshot with `getQueryData`, and write optimistic list with `setQueryData`
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: onMutate calls cancelQueries, reads snapshot via getQueryData, and writes optimistic update via setQueryData.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must read snapshot from `onError` and restore it through `setQueryData`
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: onError reads previousTodos from context and restores it via setQueryData.
onSettled calls queryClient.invalidateQueries with the ['todos'] query key.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Row press callback must trigger mutation
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Pressable onPress calls toggleMutation.mutate(todo), passing the full todo object from which id and current completed state are used in mutationFn and onMutate.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Failure text is rendered only when mutation error state is set.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Error Text is rendered unconditionally with no conditional check on toggleMutation.error or isError.
evidence: <Text style={styles.error}>Toggle failed. Cache rolled back and revalidated.</Text>
